domains.original: Finite real Euclidean state and phase pairs; all y/reference/position/momentum and all normals including zero. eta>0 under original eta<=1/beta; zero energy and rank0 are not excluded. Standard Borel structures for joint state/reference maps.
domains.reconstructed: E is finite-dimensional over ℝ, with its norm and real inner product and compatible Borel measurable structure. V maps E to ℝ; α,β belong to the nonnegative reals; η belongs to ℝ. The map c : E × E → E has inputs (y,a); h : E × E → E has inputs (a,x); R : E × E → E has inputs (n,p); S : E × (E × E) → E × E has inputs (a,z); rate : E × (E × E) → ℝ has inputs (a,z); H : E × E × (E × E) → ℝ has inputs (y,a,z). Product topology and product measurable structure are used. Division is total (division by zero is zero); square roots are real square roots. The norms in H are two separate vector norms, combined by the stated weighted sum.

constant_dependencies.reconstructed: There are no unspecified or existential constants. All numerical factors are the exact displayed 0,1,2. The definitions depend on the common ambient inner product and norm; c depends on V,η,y,a; h depends on V,a,x; R depends only on n,p and ambient operations, including total division; S depends on V,a,z through h and R and does not depend on η,α,β; rate depends on η,V,a,z; H depends on η,V,y,a,z through c. The quantification gives uniform validity subject to all assumptions, without asserting that every assumption is logically necessary.
